critical_findings.title: Multipart upload silently stores truncated objects
critical_findings.fix: Treat io.EOF/ErrUnexpectedEOF before uploadedBytes==size as a fatal error and abort the upload

critical_findings.title: sync lists only first 1000 objects; --delete can destroy local files present remotely
critical_findings.fix: Loop on result.NextToken to paginate ListObjectsV2

critical_findings.title: Guardrails parsed and tested but never enforced anywhere
critical_findings.fix: Call CheckUpload from client.Upload and from sync/watch command paths

critical_findings.title: sync down re-downloads everything on every run (mtime heuristic never matches)
WithPartSize(0) causes integer-divide-by-zero panic in MultipartUpload
Watcher swallows scan errors then deletes remote objects with --delete
critical_findings.fix: Never emit ChangeDeleted for files under paths that failed to read

critical_findings.title: WithTimeout/WithHTTPClient never wired to transports; WithProfile/WithAuditLog/WithDryRun/WithBucket are no-ops
critical_findings.fix: Pass httpClient to cloudflare.NewWithAPIToken and awsconfig; implement or delete dead options

critical_findings.title: Checksum mode never matches multipart ETags (perpetual re-upload)
critical_findings.fix: Strip -N suffix from ETag before MD5 comparison

critical_findings.title: Aborted multipart uploads leak on R2; abort reuses canceled context
critical_findings.fix: Abort with context.Background() plus timeout; GC stale /tmp state files

critical_findings.title: Content-Type never auto-detected; detectContentType is dead code
critical_findings.fix: Default cfg.contentType from detectContentType(key) on upload

critical_findings.title: --include flag accepted but never applied; no default excludes (.env, .git uploaded)
critical_findings.fix: Implement include filtering in planUp/planDown; default-exclude .git/.env/.DS_Store

critical_findings.title: DNS diff collapses duplicate records; deletion order non-deterministic
critical_findings.fix: Count duplicate keys and sort deletion entries for deterministic --json output

critical_findings.title: One failing source suppresses all metrics publishing; Profile never set
critical_findings.fix: Publish partial snapshots with per-source errors; populate Profile from active account

critical_findings.title: SSE stream has no heartbeat; proxies drop idle connections
critical_findings.fix: Send a ': ping' comment frame every ~20 seconds

critical_findings.title: Non-constant-time token compare; empty Config.Token bypasses auth
critical_findings.fix: Use crypto/subtle.ConstantTimeCompare; reject empty token in New()

critical_findings.title: KV apply does N+1 list calls for deletions
critical_findings.fix: List namespaces once before the op loop and reuse the title-to-ID map

recommendations.action: Add short-read regression test (reader shorter than declared size) and abort correctly in both multipart loops
Paginate ListRemoteObjects on NextToken with a two-page fake-backend test
Wire GuardrailChecker.CheckUpload into client.Upload and sync/watch command paths
Preserve remote mtime on downloads and normalize multipart ETags for checksum compare
Wire httpClient/timeout into cloudflare-go and AWS SDK; add ValidatePartSize to MultipartUpload
Implement or remove WithProfile/WithAuditLog/WithDryRun/WithBucket; default Content-Type via detectContentType
Suppress deletions for unreadable watch paths; retry failed watch uploads instead of advancing lastSnap
Add SSE heartbeat and partial metrics publishing with per-source error reporting

roadmap_suggestions.title: Storage engine integrity hardening
roadmap_suggestions.description: Short-read aborts, part-size validation, orphaned multipart cleanup, /tmp state GC

roadmap_suggestions.title: Make sync correct at scale
roadmap_suggestions.description: Pagination, download mtime preservation, ETag normalization, deterministic op ordering

roadmap_suggestions.title: Enforce declared guardrails
roadmap_suggestions.description: Wire .cosmoflare.yaml guardrails/audit/dry-run into mutation paths so config stops being advisory

roadmap_suggestions.title: Live-metrics reliability
roadmap_suggestions.description: SSE keepalive, partial-snapshot publishing, byte-based delta detection
